mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, first_name, last_name, title, specialty, bio, phone, address, city, latitude, longitude, active, created_at, updated_at, (6371.0 * ACOS(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE))) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE))) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(longitude AS DOUBLE)) - RADIANS(CAST(#{lng} AS DOUBLE))) + SIN(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE))) * SIN(RADIANS(CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE))) )))) AS distance_km FROM professional_profiles WHERE active = TRUE AND CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE) - (CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / 111.0) AND CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE) + (CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / 111.0) AND CAST(longitude AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN CAST(#{lng} AS DOUBLE) - (CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / (111.0 * COS(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE))))) AND CAST(#{lng} AS DOUBLE) + (CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) / (111.0 * COS(RADIANS(CAST(#{lat} AS DOUBLE))))) AND (#{specialty} IS NULL OR LOWER(specialty) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{specialty}), '%')) ) nearby WHERE distance_km <= CAST(#{radiusKm} AS DOUBLE) ORDER BY distance_km ASC
